summaryDeep: Their questions, explanations, and way of talking work smoothly with your judgment about what's possible. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
tension: The challenge is that this connection asks for participation. Its gifts tend to appear in the exchange itself. If you keep your thoughts tucked away until they are fully formed, you may never discover what this person could have helped you uncover.
advice: Let them into the process before you have all the answers. Share the unfinished version. Sometimes their perspective reveals a path you could not have found alone.
